Home.headline: See what employers are asking for.
Home.headlineEm: Then ask someone who does the work.
Home.lede: Follow skills and roles across Australian job ads — every number explains itself — and turn any signal into a 20-minute chat with someone who has the skill.
Home.promise: Free for students · No one can pay to change what the market shows · No account needed to browse
Home.signalsNote: Signals describe the market. They don’t tell you what to learn — your interests and time matter more.
Home.howTitle: From a number to a conversation
Home.step1Body: Track skills and roles with your own filter — say, entry-level on-site in Sydney plus remote anywhere in Australia.
Home.step2Body: Each figure carries its definition, denominator, source and date one click away. Small samples are flagged, not charted.
Home.step3Body: When a signal is worth digging into, we match you with up to three verified practitioners and suggest what to ask.
Home.principlesTitle: No rankings. No readiness scores. Just direction.

principles.p1: We never rank you against other students or give you a score.
principles.p2: Anything we guess about you is labelled as a suggestion, and one tap to change.
principles.p3: Demand is one input. Every recommendation also shows effort and how transferable a skill is.
principles.p4: Practitioners opt in and verify their work email. Silence and declines are handled privately — you always get a next step.

Home.practitionerTitle: Started in the last few years? Give 20 minutes a month.
Home.practitionerBody: You’ll always see why a student picked you, what they want to decide, and you can say no in one click — no reason needed.
Home.sampleNote: Numbers on this preview are illustrative.
